name: Arta Video Yar
author: kian babaabady

sections.description:
Arta Video Yar embeds videos from Iranian VOD hosts without loading a heavy third-party iframe until the visitor clicks play. Add a video once to the gallery, then reuse it anywhere with a shortcode, block, or widget.

Features:

  • Click-to-play posters (better for Core Web Vitals)
  • Central video gallery: add once, reuse everywhere
  • Duplicate detection by platform + video ID
  • Gutenberg block, optional Elementor widget, Classic Editor modal
  • Compact VideoObject JSON-LD for search

External services

Arta Video Yar relies on third-party video hosts. It does not send analytics to the plugin author.

For every built-in host below:

  • When an editor adds or refreshes a video, your WordPress server may request that host’s public video page and/or public API (WordPress HTTP API / wp_safe_remote_get) to read title, poster, duration, and related metadata. Data sent: the video URL or video ID, plus standard server HTTP data (server IP address and user agent).
  • On the front end, the visitor’s browser may load the poster image URL on page view.
  • The third-party player iframe loads in the visitor’s browser only after they click play. That request is made by the visitor to the host and typically includes the visitor’s IP address, user agent, and referring page.

Aparat (https://www.aparat.com): Iranian video host used for metadata import and click-to-play embeds. Metadata may use https://www.aparat.com/etc/api/video/videohash/{id} and/or the public watch page.
Terms of service: https://www.aparat.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.aparat.com/privacy

Namasha (https://www.namasha.com): Iranian video host used for metadata import (public page Open Graph tags when available) and click-to-play embeds.
Terms of service: https://www.namasha.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.namasha.com/privacy

Tamasha (https://www.tamasha.com): Iranian video host used for metadata import (public page Open Graph tags when available) and click-to-play embeds.
Terms of use: https://www.tamasha.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.tamasha.com/privacy

mp4.ir (https://www.mp4.ir): Iranian video host used for metadata import (public page Open Graph tags when available) and click-to-play embeds.
Terms of use: https://www.mp4.ir/rules
Privacy policy: https://www.mp4.ir/rules (mp4.ir publishes usage rules that include account/viewing-data wording; no separate privacy URL is published)

Dalfak (https://www.dalfak.com): Iranian video host used for metadata import (public page Open Graph tags when available) and click-to-play embeds.
Terms of service: https://www.dalfak.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.dalfak.com/policy

Ifilo (https://ifilo.net): Iranian video host used for metadata import (public page Open Graph tags when available) and click-to-play embeds.
Terms / site rules: https://ifilo.net/linkApprovalRules
Privacy policy: https://ifilo.net/ (Ifilo does not publish a dedicated privacy-policy URL; visitor browser requests for posters/embeds are subject to Ifilo’s site policies)

Jabeh (https://jabeh.com): Iranian video host used for metadata import (public page Open Graph tags when available) and click-to-play embeds.
Terms of service: https://jabeh.com/page/terms
Privacy policy: https://jabeh.com/page/terms (privacy commitments are included in Jabeh’s terms document; no separate privacy URL is published)

Tiliv (https://www.tiliv.tv): Iranian video host used for metadata import (public page meta tags when available) and click-to-play embeds.
Terms of service: https://www.tiliv.tv/
Privacy policy: https://www.tiliv.tv/ (Tiliv does not publish dedicated public terms or privacy-policy URLs at this time; visitor browser requests for posters/embeds are subject to Tiliv’s site policies)

Custom iframe embeds. Site administrators and editors can embed a video from any HTTPS host they choose. The plugin does not contact a third party on the server for these. When a visitor clicks play, their browser loads the iframe from the host the editor entered. That host receives the visitor’s IP address, user agent, and referring page under its own terms and privacy policy. You are responsible for confirming any custom host meets your privacy and legal obligations.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the arta-video-yar folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate Arta Video Yar through the Plugins screen
  3. Open Arta Video Yar > Video Gallery to add videos
  4. Embed with [videoyar id="123"], the Arta Video Yar block, or the Elementor widget
sections.faq:
Which platforms are supported?

Version 1.0 supports Aparat, Namasha, Tamasha, mp4.ir, Dalfak, Ifilo, Jabeh, Tiliv, and a Custom iframe fallback. Paste a public video URL, an HTTPS iframe player URL, or an iframe embed snippet. Known hosts are detected automatically. Other HTTPS iframe URLs are stored as Custom.

Is Elementor required?

No. The Elementor widget only registers when Elementor is active.

What happens if I paste the same URL twice?

The plugin reuses the existing library item (same platform + video ID). Your pages still embed the video, and the library stays free of duplicates.

Are videos deleted on uninstall?

Only if you enable Delete data on uninstall in Arta Video Yar > Settings. By default, library videos stay in the database and only plugin options are removed.
sections.changelog:
1.0.36

  • Sanitize and validate admin/AJAX inputs; reject non-scalar values before meta save; clear gallery-view user meta on uninstall.

1.0.35

  • Clarify External services disclosure (what/why/when/data + terms/privacy links per host).

1.0.34

  • Brand as Arta Video Yar (arta-video-yar).

1.0.32

  • Initial WordPress.org release: facade embeds, video library, editors, VideoObject schema, and security hardening.
